title: Lucky Digit

examples.explanation: 9 + 8 + 7 + 5 = 29, then 2 + 9 = 11, then 1 + 1 = 2. 7 is already one digit, and so is 0.

hints: Write a loop that replaces the number by the sum of its digits until it has one digit. How many rounds can that take for a number with 19 digits?
The numbers can have up to 19 digits. Reading them as text is safe in any language, and summing the characters is the first round.
Going further: the result equals 1 + (N − 1) mod 9 for N > 0, because a number and its digit sum leave the same remainder when divided by 9.
